about: Senior architect who enjoys turning tangled legacy estates into clean, well-bounded service landscapes. I care about pragmatic decisions, clear documentation, and bringing engineering teams along rather than dictating from an ivory tower.

experiences.description: Owns the target architecture for a multi-team platform modernisation, defining service boundaries and integration contracts across squads. Chairs the architecture review board and coaches lead engineers on trade-off analysis. Acts as the technical face to senior stakeholders during quarterly planning.

Led the architectural redesign of a regional fulfilment platform serving several business lines. Established reference architectures and a lightweight governance process that cut delivery friction between teams. Mentored a growing group of mid-level engineers stepping into design ownership.

Designed the backbone for a customer-facing portal rebuilt from a monolith into independently deployable services. Partnered with product leads to sequence the migration so the business kept shipping throughout. Introduced design records that became the team's shared decision log.

Built integration layers connecting internal tooling to several third-party platforms. Drove proof-of-concept work that de-risked a major replatforming initiative. Worked closely with delivery managers to keep scope honest and deadlines realistic.

Delivered features across a shared services codebase and helped stabilise a flaky release pipeline. Paired regularly with junior developers to lift overall code quality. Contributed to early design discussions that shaped the team's component conventions.

projects.title: Counsel Document Review Simulator
projects.summary: Built an automated testing harness for an interactive review tool used by an in-house legal team. Defined the test strategy and regression suites that caught defects before each release. The work gave the legal staff confidence to adopt the tool for high-stakes matters.

projects.title: Retail Banking Migration Programme
projects.summary: Coordinated a cross-functional effort to move a core banking workflow onto a new data and deployment foundation. Managed the delivery plan, dependencies, and risk register across infrastructure and mobile streams. Kept stakeholders aligned through a phased rollout with clear go/no-go gates.

projects.title: Omnichannel Catalogue Platform
projects.summary: Architected a shared catalogue service spanning fashion retail and a regulated pharmaceuticals line. Reconciled very different compliance and performance needs into one extensible design. Set the integration patterns that downstream teams reused for later channels.
